purpose: Verify successful creation of a basic user account with valid institutional identity data.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects user type (Student), enters unique Institute ID, valid institute email, and mandatory personal data, then submits.
expected_result: Account is created, internal user ID and initial credentials are generated, baseline dashboard access is enabled, audit log is written, and welcome message is sent.

purpose: Verify canceling account creation before submission results in no account created.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated and on the Create User screen.
action_or_input: Super Admin enters user details but selects Cancel before submission.
expected_result: Operation is canceled and no user account is created in the system.

purpose: Verify correctable validation errors are displayed allowing user data entry correction.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits form missing mandatory type-specific fields.
expected_result: System displays validation errors and returns to the data entry screen without committing any record.

purpose: Verify rejection of user creation when duplicate Institute ID or duplicate identity is submitted.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; a basic user with Institute ID 'INST001' already exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits creation of a new user with Institute ID 'INST001'.
expected_result: Creation is rejected with duplicate error message; no account is created.

purpose: Verify account remains created when notification service fails after creation.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; Notification Service is set to simulate failure.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits valid basic user creation data.
expected_result: Account is created successfully, dashboard access is enabled, but notification delivery failure is logged for retry/attention.

purpose: Verify Super Admin can view permitted user profile details without module-specific operational content.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target basic user exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin searches and opens the user profile record.
expected_result: System displays permitted profile information and lifecycle status summary without revealing restricted operational content.

purpose: Verify routing to archived-user view when selecting an archived user.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user account is archived.
action_or_input: Super Admin opens the user record.
expected_result: System routes to the read-only archived-user view maintaining data restrictions.

purpose: Verify behavior when accessing a non-existent or unpermitted user record.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to open a user record with an invalid user ID.
expected_result: System displays an appropriate 'user not found' or access error message.

purpose: Verify updating editable user profile fields while keeping Institute ID non-editable.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin updates editable fields (e.g., contact email, phone) and submits with reason context.
expected_result: System validates and saves updated profile; change timestamp, actor, changed fields, and reason are recorded in audit log.

purpose: Verify canceling edit profile leaves original data unchanged.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin modifies editable fields but clicks Cancel.
expected_result: No changes are saved to the user profile.

purpose: Verify rejection when attempting to change immutable Institute ID.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits a request attempting to modify the Institute ID field.
expected_result: Operation is rejected due to immutable Institute ID constraint.

purpose: Verify rejection when submitting invalid institute email or type-specific data during profile update.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits an invalid institute email address syntax during update.
expected_result: Update is rejected with validation feedback; original profile remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify deactivation of an active user and automatic revocation/inactivation of assigned roles.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user is active with assigned roles.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects Deactivate User, inputs mandatory reason, and confirms critical prompt.
expected_result: Account is marked deactivated, assigned roles are inactivated/revoked, status change is recorded, and deactivation notice is sent.

purpose: Verify canceling deactivation confirmation keeps account active.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user is active.
action_or_input: Super Admin initiates deactivation but cancels at the confirmation dialog.
expected_result: Deactivation is canceled; user account remains active.

purpose: Verify rejection of deactivation operation when target user is already deactivated or archived.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user is already deactivated.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to perform Deactivate User on the deactivated user.
expected_result: Operation is rejected because user is not in a deactivatable state.

purpose: Verify reactivation of a deactivated user restores only valid baseline access.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user is deactivated and not archived; reactivation is policy-allowed.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects deactivated user, confirms reactivation.
expected_result: Account state becomes active, baseline access is restored (expired/revoked additional roles are not recreated), and status transition is logged.

purpose: Verify reactivation workflow requests profile correction when profile data requires updates.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; deactivated user profile requires mandatory updates.
action_or_input: Super Admin initiates reactivation for the user.
expected_result: System prompts for required profile updates before allowing reactivation to proceed.

purpose: Verify rejection of reactivation if target user is archived.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user is archived.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to execute Reactivate User on the archived user.
expected_result: Reactivation operation is rejected by the system.

purpose: Verify bulk user creation from a valid CSV template containing valid records.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; valid CSV file with 50 records structured per template.
action_or_input: Super Admin uploads CSV, previews summary, and confirms batch execution.
expected_result: Accounts are created, notifications sent, detailed log/processing summary generated, and Super Admin notified.

purpose: Verify record-level validation errors are identified during CSV upload preview.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; CSV contains 2 valid rows and 1 invalid row.
action_or_input: Super Admin uploads the CSV file.
expected_result: System presents preview summary identifying the invalid row before final processing confirmation.

purpose: Verify canceling bulk creation after preview leaves database unchanged.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; valid CSV uploaded.
action_or_input: Super Admin views preview summary and clicks Cancel.
expected_result: No batch processing occurs and no accounts are created.

purpose: Verify rejection of bulk user creation when uploading an invalid template/file.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin uploads a non-CSV file or corrupted template.
expected_result: System rejects file with an invalid template/file error message.

purpose: Verify rejection of bulk user creation file exceeding 1000 records limit.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; CSV file contains 1001 records.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to upload the 1001-record CSV file.
expected_result: Upload is rejected due to hard record limit (>1000 records).

purpose: Verify accurate reporting of committed and failed rows when processing service fails mid-batch.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; batch service is interrupted during execution.
action_or_input: Super Admin executes bulk creation of a valid 10-record CSV.
expected_result: Processing log accurately reports which rows were committed before failure and which failed.

purpose: Verify successful bulk status update (deactivation) for multiple eligible users.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; 5 active target users exist.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects the 5 active users, chooses bulk deactivation, reviews preview, and confirms.
expected_result: All 5 users are deactivated, associated role access consequences applied, audit log/summary produced, and notification sent.

purpose: Verify system identifies ineligible targets in preview before bulk status update execution.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; batch includes 3 active users and 2 already-archived users.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects the 5 users for bulk deactivation.
expected_result: System preview highlights the 2 ineligible archived targets before execution.

purpose: Verify rejection when bulk status update count exceeds 1000 limit or uses an unsupported action.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; selection contains 1005 users.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to submit bulk status update for 1005 users.
expected_result: Operation is rejected due to exceeding maximum allowed bulk limit.

purpose: Verify assigning an additional time-bound role to an eligible basic user.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target basic user exists; non-conflicting time-bound role is available.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects user and role, enters current start date, valid end date, scope, reason, and confirms.
expected_result: Role assignment is saved as Active, history updated, exposed in user dashboard context, and notification sent.

purpose: Verify recording a future-dated role assignment as scheduled.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; eligible basic user and role available.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns role specifying a future start date and mandatory reason.
expected_result: Assignment is successfully recorded in 'Scheduled' state for automatic future activation.

purpose: Verify assigning a permanent role omitting an end date.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; eligible user and permanent-capable role selected.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns role with valid start date, omitting end date.
expected_result: Permanent role assignment is recorded successfully as Active.

purpose: Verify rejection of role assignment when violating user eligibility, singularity, or conflict rules.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; role R1 is a singular role already active on User A.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to assign singular role R1 to User B.
expected_result: Assignment is rejected with singular role conflict reason; existing assignments remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify reassigning an existing role assignment to a new user with effective-date handover.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; active role assignment exists for User A; User B is eligible.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects assignment, selects User B, specifies effective date and reason, and confirms.
expected_result: On effective date, User A access is removed, User B access is granted, pending tasks are transferred via system services, prior-holder audit access preserved, and both notified.

purpose: Verify scheduling a future-dated role reassignment handover.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; active role assignment exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin inputs a future effective date for role reassignment.
expected_result: Reassignment is recorded as scheduled for the future effective date.

purpose: Verify immediate effective execution of emergency role reassignment.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; active role assignment exists; proposed holder eligible.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects Emergency Reassignment with immediate effective date.
expected_result: Role access and pending tasks immediately transfer to the new holder.

purpose: Verify rejection of reassignment when proposed new holder is ineligible or conflicting.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; proposed user has configured role conflict with target role.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to reassign role to conflicting user.
expected_result: Reassignment is rejected; original user retains the role assignment.

purpose: Verify standard role revocation before end date with effective date, reason, and task transfer/closure.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target active role assignment exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects Standard Revocation, inputs valid future effective date (meeting notice rules), mandatory reason, and task disposition 'transfer', then confirms.
expected_result: Role access removal and pending task transfer occur on effective date; user and module admins notified.

purpose: Verify future standard revocation remains in scheduled state until effective date.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; active role assignment exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin schedules a standard revocation effective in 3 days.
expected_result: Revocation is scheduled; role remains active until the effective date is reached.

purpose: Verify emergency role revocation executes immediately bypassing standard notice period.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; active role assignment exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects Emergency Revocation with immediate effective date and submits reason.
expected_result: Role access is removed immediately, task disposition is executed, and notifications dispatched.

purpose: Verify rejection of standard revocation when effective date violates minimum notice policy.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; policy requires at least 1 day notice for standard revocation.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects Standard Revocation with immediate/same-day effective date.
expected_result: Operation is rejected due to violation of minimum notice policy.

purpose: Verify extending the validity end date of an active time-bound role.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; active time-bound role assignment exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin opens role assignment, inputs a new later end date, mandatory reason, and confirms.
expected_result: Role end date is updated, history updated, and affected user is notified.

purpose: Verify decision not to extend role allows natural role expiry.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; time-bound role near expiry.
action_or_input: Super Admin reviews expiry alert and chooses no extension.
expected_result: Role validity period is unchanged; role will expire naturally at configured end date.

purpose: Verify rejection when extending role validity to an invalid date or causing conflict.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; time-bound role active.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits an extension end date earlier than the current start/end date.
expected_result: Extension request is rejected; original end date remains intact.

purpose: Verify read-only inspection of role metadata, availability status, current holders, and history.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin opens Role Directory and filters/searches roles including vacant ones.
expected_result: System displays non-editable role metadata, current holders, scope, and past history without edit capabilities.

purpose: Verify status display for deprecated or temporarily unavailable roles.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; deprecated role exists in directory.
action_or_input: Super Admin searches and opens deprecated role metadata.
expected_result: System displays role status as deprecated/unavailable and does not offer normal assignment options.

purpose: Verify handling when role metadata directory service is unavailable.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; Role Directory service is simulated offline.
action_or_input: Super Admin opens Role Directory.
expected_result: System displays error reporting that the directory cannot be loaded.

purpose: Verify basic user switching active role session context when assigned multiple valid roles.
preconditions: Basic user is logged in and possesses two active valid assigned roles (Role A and Role B).
action_or_input: User opens role switcher and selects Role B.
expected_result: System validates Role B is active, updates active-role context to Role B, and refreshes dashboard/module access options.

purpose: Verify selecting already-active role requires no material context change.
preconditions: Basic user is logged in with Role A currently active.
action_or_input: User opens role switcher and re-selects Role A.
expected_result: System retains active context for Role A without error or unnecessary state re-initialization.

purpose: Verify active role switch denial when selected role has expired or been revoked since display.
preconditions: Basic user is logged in; Role B is revoked in background while active session is running.
action_or_input: User attempts to switch to Role B.
expected_result: Role switch is denied, user is notified, and role list is refreshed.

purpose: Verify granting module access permitted by active role permissions.
preconditions: Basic user is logged in with active Role A which has permission for Module X.
action_or_input: User clicks link to access Module X.
expected_result: System evaluates Role A permissions, grants access to Module X, and logs access metadata.

purpose: Verify user switching active role to access a module denied under previous role.
preconditions: Basic user has Role A (no permission for Module Y) and Role B (has permission for Module Y).
action_or_input: User switches active role to Role B and clicks Module Y link.
expected_result: Module Y access is granted under authorized Role B context.

purpose: Verify access denial when active role becomes inactive during access evaluation.
preconditions: Basic user clicks module link; active role state transitions to inactive concurrently.
action_or_input: User attempts to open module link.
expected_result: Access is denied, system refreshes user role context, and unauthorized content is not disclosed.

purpose: Verify moving an eligible deactivated user to the archive after minimum deactivation interval.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user is deactivated; minimum interval elapsed; no pending transactions.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects deactivated user, archival date, reason, retention option, and confirms critical prompt with auth.
expected_result: Remaining roles/credentials disabled, retained record moved to archive, user listed under Archived Users, audit logged, notification sent.

purpose: Verify processing archival for multiple individually selected eligible deactivated users.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; 3 eligible deactivated users selected.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits batch user archival with reason and critical auth confirmation.
expected_result: All 3 selected eligible users are moved to archive with credentials disabled and audit logged.

purpose: Verify rejection of user archival if minimum deactivation interval has not elapsed or pending transaction exists.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user was deactivated today (minimum interval not met).
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to archive the user.
expected_result: Archival is rejected due to unfulfilled minimum deactivation interval precondition.

purpose: Verify original user data protection when archive storage failure occurs during archival.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; archive repository service is set to fail.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to perform user archival.
expected_result: Archival fails, original deactivated user data remains protected in primary store, failure is logged.

purpose: Verify historical data archival by category and date range following backup creation.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; data category is archive-enabled and retention requirements met.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects category and date range, reviews dependency summary, confirms with authentication.
expected_result: Backup is created, eligible data moved to archive database, archival summary generated, and operation logged.

purpose: Verify handling and preview display when some historical records in range are ineligible.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; range includes active dependency records.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects date range for historical data archival.
expected_result: System identifies and excludes ineligible records, displaying impact preview before confirmation.

purpose: Verify historical data archival does not proceed when pending actions block all selected data.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; all selected records have pending operational dependencies.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to execute historical data archival.
expected_result: Archival process is blocked and does not proceed.

purpose: Verify abortion of historical archival operation when backup creation fails.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; Backup Service is set to simulate failure.
action_or_input: Super Admin confirms historical data archival.
expected_result: Archival is aborted due to backup failure; no active historical data is moved.

purpose: Verify searching and viewing permitted archived records in read-only mode.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; archived records exist.
action_or_input: Super Admin opens Archive Search, enters search criteria, and selects an archived record.
expected_result: Matching permitted archived metadata is displayed in read-only mode without exposing restricted content.

purpose: Verify empty result set display when archive search yields no matches.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin searches archive with non-existent criteria.
expected_result: System displays an empty result set without errors.

purpose: Verify system prevents exposure of restricted operational content during archive search.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits query attempting to retrieve restricted operational record details.
expected_result: System suppresses restricted operational content and returns only permitted metadata.

purpose: Verify restoring an archived user within the reversible period with required authorization.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; archived user is within reversible period; authorization recorded.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects archived user, reviews impact, and confirms with authentication.
expected_result: User record is restored to active store, baseline access re-established per current policy, transition audited.

purpose: Verify prompt for required profile/status review upon user restoration.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target archived user restored within reversible period.
action_or_input: Super Admin completes user restoration confirmation.
expected_result: Restored user is flagged for mandatory profile/status review prior to normal use.

purpose: Verify rejection of user restoration when required authorization evidence is missing.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; user is within reversible period; authorization absent.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to restore archived user without providing approval authorization.
expected_result: Restoration request is rejected.

purpose: Verify rejection of user restoration attempt when reversible period has elapsed (ISS-SA-004).
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target user's reversible archival period has expired.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to restore the archived user.
expected_result: Restoration is rejected; account remains permanently archived and non-restorable.

purpose: Verify restoring archived historical data to active system when required approval exists.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target historical data set is restorable and approval is recorded.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects archived data set, reviews impact, confirms with authentication.
expected_result: Data is restored to active store in a controlled manner and operation is logged.

purpose: Verify restoring an approved subset of archived historical data.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; approval granted specifically for Subset A of archived data.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects and restores approved Subset A.
expected_result: Only approved Subset A is restored to active store; remaining data stays archived.

purpose: Verify rejection of historical data restoration when approval is missing or dependencies block it.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; approval evidence missing for target data set.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to execute data restoration.
expected_result: Operation is rejected; archived data remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify generating archive reports and exporting results to CSV or PDF.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; permitted archive data available.
action_or_input: Super Admin specifies report criteria, generates read-only report, and clicks Export to PDF.
expected_result: Report is generated and exported in PDF format; export action is recorded in audit log.

purpose: Verify pagination/batching when generating archive report for large result set.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; large volume of archived records exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin generates archive report matching 5000 records.
expected_result: System applies pagination/batching to display the read-only report without UI degradation.

purpose: Verify exclusion of restricted operational fields when exporting archive reports.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin requests archive export including fields mapped to restricted operational content.
expected_result: System excludes restricted fields from the report/export package.

purpose: Verify generating an authorized export package of archived data for external storage.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; archive data is eligible for external export.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects archive set, selects export package options, and confirms critical action.
expected_result: Authorized export package is generated and audit operation recorded.

purpose: Verify generating metadata-only export package when operational content export is restricted.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target category restricts operational data payload.
action_or_input: Super Admin exports archive package for external storage.
expected_result: System generates a metadata-only export package omitting operational content details.

purpose: Verify rejection of archive export when policy or access validation fails.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; user lacks export permissions for target archive segment.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to initiate archive export.
expected_result: Export request is rejected.

purpose: Verify requesting permanent data purge for retention-expired archived data.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target data is archived and retention period has elapsed.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects archived data set, confirms impact with auth, and submits purge request.
expected_result: Super Admin authorization recorded; request transitions to 'Pending IT Head Authorization' state; data remains archived.

purpose: Verify canceling purge request before submission creates no pending authorization request.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; retention-expired archived data selected.
action_or_input: Super Admin views destructive impact screen and clicks Cancel.
expected_result: Operation is canceled; no purge request is submitted.

purpose: Verify rejection of permanent purge request if retention period has not elapsed.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; archived data retention period is still active.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to request permanent purge on unexpired archived data.
expected_result: Purge request is rejected due to active retention period.

purpose: Verify IT Head dual-authorization approval executing permanent data purge.
preconditions: IT Head is authenticated; valid pending purge request exists with Super Admin authorization.
action_or_input: IT Head reviews metadata/impact summary and selects Approve.
expected_result: Second authorization recorded, permanent data purge executed, and decision audited.

purpose: Verify leaving purge request in pending state when IT Head exits without making a decision.
preconditions: IT Head is authenticated; valid pending purge request exists.
action_or_input: IT Head opens request details and exits without clicking Approve or Reject.
expected_result: Request remains in 'Pending IT Head Authorization' state; no data is purged.

purpose: Verify rejection of authorization decision when request is no longer eligible or already decided.
preconditions: IT Head is authenticated; target purge request was already rejected/processed in another session.
action_or_input: IT Head attempts to submit an approval decision on the stale request.
expected_result: Decision submission is rejected.

purpose: Verify read-only inspection of immutable Super Admin audit logs with filtering.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; audit entries exist.
action_or_input: Super Admin opens Audit Log and applies filters (date range, action type).
expected_result: Matching immutable audit entries and details are displayed read-only.

purpose: Verify empty result display when audit log search matches no records.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin applies audit log filters that match zero entries.
expected_result: System displays an empty result set without error.

purpose: Verify system failure message display when audit log service is offline.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; Audit Log Service is simulated offline.
action_or_input: Super Admin opens Audit Log.
expected_result: System reports log service failure without modifying or losing any stored logs.

purpose: Verify generating and exporting configurable audit reports to PDF/Excel.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; audit data sources available.
action_or_input: Super Admin selects report parameters, views tabular/graphical output, and exports to Excel.
expected_result: Audit report is generated, exported to Excel format, and export activity is logged in audit system.

purpose: Verify report generation indication when parameters match no audit data.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin inputs audit report parameters matching no records.
expected_result: Report is generated displaying a clear 'no data available' indicator.

purpose: Verify exclusion of prohibited operational data from generated audit reports.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin configures report parameters targeting operational module activity details.
expected_result: Restricted operational content is excluded from the output report.

purpose: Verify display of Super Admin dashboard metrics without operational content disclosure.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; metric sources active.
action_or_input: Super Admin opens module dashboard.
expected_result: Aggregated user counts, role metrics, expiry warnings, archive volume, system health, active sessions, and failed-login stats are displayed.

purpose: Verify handling when a dashboard metric source is temporarily unavailable.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; failed-login metric provider is offline.
action_or_input: Super Admin opens dashboard.
expected_result: Dashboard renders available metrics while clearly marking the failed-login metric as unavailable/stale without fabricating data.

purpose: Verify error handling when entire dashboard service fails.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; Dashboard service is unavailable.
action_or_input: Super Admin opens dashboard.
expected_result: System gracefully displays a service failure message.

purpose: Verify updating permitted system-wide configuration parameters with critical confirmation.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; target parameter (e.g., session timeout) is within permitted set.
action_or_input: Super Admin edits session timeout within policy limits, confirms critical prompt with auth.
expected_result: New parameter value is saved, applied system-wide, and recorded in audit log.

purpose: Verify canceling system configuration modification leaves settings unchanged.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin changes notification preference value but clicks Cancel.
expected_result: No configuration changes are committed.

purpose: Verify rejection when attempting to modify forbidden operational or academic configs.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits request to edit academic calendar or financial workflow rules.
expected_result: Operation is denied by access control guardrails; parameters remain unchanged.

purpose: Verify rejection of parameter value exceeding policy bounds (e.g., bulk limit > 1000).
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts to set bulk operation limit parameter to 1500.
expected_result: Value is rejected as out of policy bounds.

purpose: Verify automatic activation of a scheduled role assignment when start date/time is reached.
preconditions: A valid scheduled role assignment exists for Active User A; start date/time arrives.
action_or_input: System time reaches configured role-assignment start date/time.
expected_result: System updates role status to Active, enables permissions for User A, exposes role in context, and logs transition.

purpose: Verify superseded scheduled assignment is not activated upon reaching start date.
preconditions: Scheduled role assignment was revoked/superseded prior to start date.
action_or_input: System time reaches original start date/time of the superseded assignment.
expected_result: No role activation occurs; existing superseded state is preserved.

purpose: Verify activation fails and is logged if target user is no longer active at scheduled start time.
preconditions: User associated with scheduled role assignment is deactivated prior to start date.
action_or_input: System time reaches start date/time.
expected_result: System does not activate role assignment; failed transition is logged for administrative attention.

purpose: Verify automatic expiration of a time-bound role when effective end date/time is reached.
preconditions: An active time-bound role assignment reaches its configured end date/time.
action_or_input: System time reaches effective role end date/time.
expected_result: Role assignment is marked Expired/Inactive, role access is removed, history preserved, and user notified.

purpose: Verify role with extended validity does not expire on original superseded end date.
preconditions: Role end date was validly extended from Date T1 to Date T2.
action_or_input: System time reaches original end date T1.
expected_result: System evaluates revised end date T2; role remains active and does not expire at T1.

purpose: Verify logging and non-silent failure handling when lifecycle status update fails.
preconditions: Role lifecycle update service encounters a database write error at expiry time.
action_or_input: System time reaches role end date/time.
expected_result: Role state is not silently altered; error is logged for recovery/attention.

purpose: Verify sending role-expiry reminder when lead-time point is reached for active role.
preconditions: Active time-bound role exists; system time reaches configured lead-time point before expiry.
action_or_input: System time reaches lead-time point.
expected_result: Expiry reminder notifications are sent to Super Admin and affected user; outcome recorded.

purpose: Verify suppression of obsolete reminder when end date was extended before dispatch.
preconditions: Time-bound role end date was extended, moving expiry into the far future.
action_or_input: System evaluates reminder trigger for original end date.
expected_result: System detects updated end date and suppresses obsolete expiry reminder dispatch.

purpose: Verify delivery channel failure does not affect role lifecycle state during reminder dispatch.
preconditions: Notification delivery service fails during reminder dispatch.
action_or_input: System triggers role-expiry reminder dispatch.
expected_result: Role lifecycle state remains unchanged (Active); delivery failure is logged for retry.

purpose: Verify marking archived user as permanently non-restorable when reversible period expires (ISS-SA-004).
preconditions: Archived user account reaches the end of the configured reversible archival period without restoration.
action_or_input: System time reaches reversible archival period expiration.
expected_result: Lifecycle status is updated to permanent/non-restorable, data preserved, and transition logged.

purpose: Verify no permanent-archive transition occurs if user was restored before reversible window expired.
preconditions: Archived user was validly restored during reversible period.
action_or_input: System time reaches original reversible window expiration date.
expected_result: No permanent-archive transition occurs; active restored status is maintained.

purpose: Verify failure to commit permanent transition preserves archived state and does not enable restoration.
preconditions: System encounters storage error when committing permanent non-restorable lifecycle status.
action_or_input: System time reaches reversible archival period expiration.
expected_result: Current archived state is preserved, commit failure is logged, and restoration remains prohibited.

purpose: Verify logging failed login attempts and triggering security alert on 5th consecutive failure.
preconditions: Super Admin login monitoring active; 4 consecutive failed logins recorded.
action_or_input: 5th consecutive failed Super Admin authentication attempt occurs.
expected_result: 5th failure is logged in audit log, security alert is created and dispatched over configured channels.

purpose: Verify failed login attempt below threshold of 5 is logged without dispatching security alert.
preconditions: Super Admin login attempt fails (failure count = 3).
action_or_input: 3rd failed authentication attempt occurs.
expected_result: Attempt is logged in audit trail, but no security threshold alert is dispatched.

purpose: Verify alert state and audit logs remain recorded if alert notification delivery fails.
preconditions: 5th consecutive failed login occurs; alert delivery channel fails.
action_or_input: 5th failed authentication attempt is processed.
expected_result: Failed attempt and alert state remain recorded in system logs; delivery failure logged.

purpose: Verify successful Super Admin authentication requiring credentials, strong password, 2FA, and single active session.
preconditions: Super Admin account exists; 2FA configured; no existing active session.
action_or_input: Super Admin enters correct credentials, passes IP whitelist (if enabled), and completes 2FA.
expected_result: Exactly one valid Super Admin session is established and login audit event is logged.

purpose: Verify mandatory password rotation requirement upon authentication when password interval is due.
preconditions: Super Admin password rotation interval has expired.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits valid credentials and 2FA.
expected_result: System requires mandatory password change before establishing session.

purpose: Verify successful authentication when optional IP whitelist is disabled.
preconditions: IP whitelist enforcement is disabled in configuration.
action_or_input: Super Admin authenticates from an unlisted IP address with valid credentials and 2FA.
expected_result: Authentication succeeds and session is established without IP restriction.

purpose: Verify authentication failure when credentials, IP check, or 2FA verification fails.
preconditions: Super Admin account exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin inputs incorrect 2FA token.
expected_result: No session established; failed authentication event sent to UC-SA-032.

purpose: Verify rejection of new login attempt when another Super Admin session is already active.
preconditions: An active Super Admin session already exists.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts second concurrent login from another browser/device.
expected_result: New session creation is rejected due to single active session constraint.

purpose: Verify automatic termination of Super Admin session upon reaching configured inactivity timeout.
preconditions: Super Admin session is active and inactive duration reaches configured timeout.
action_or_input: Configured inactivity timeout duration elapses without user interaction.
expected_result: Session is automatically terminated, session log updated, and subsequent actions require re-authentication.

purpose: Verify user activity prior to timeout resets inactivity timer.
preconditions: Super Admin session active; timeout set to 15 minutes; 14 minutes elapsed.
action_or_input: Super Admin performs an administrative action (e.g., clicks page link).
expected_result: Session remains active; inactivity timer is reset to 0.

purpose: Verify session security control failure handling does not leave session silently valid.
preconditions: Session infrastructure encounters error during timeout cleanup processing.
action_or_input: Inactivity duration elapses.
